blurb: Brevard Equestrian Center is situated on 36 acres in Grant, FL, providing boarding, training, paddock & pasture turnouts, and lessons. The center also hosts week-long riding programs during school breaks, clinics, working student opportunities, riding demonstrations, and educational programs for younger riders. Emphasis is on safe, classical, and correct riding for all ages, with a community-focused environment. Facilities also support competition circuit riders due to proximity to major Florida
